name: UI frames & icon sheet
oneLiner: A generated, style-locked UI kit (nine-slice window and small frames, a selection frame, an item slot, a pointer and a 24-icon sheet), cut into game-ready files and drawn by a small helper that keeps corners unstretched at any size, centres icons at one scale and falls back to the game's old panels and shapes when a file is missing; it also registers into the skin bitmap roles so the shop and window modules pick it up.
fits: RPG and adventure menus, shops, bags and dialogue boxes
crafting, farming and life sims with item grids
any HD game moving from code-drawn panels and shape icons to painted UI
notFor: pixel-art styles (pixel8, pixel16, handheld4): painted frames on a 256x224 grid read as smeared; pixel skins ignore the kit's global registrations by design
games that need UI art generated at runtime (no generator is called by the game)
text baked into art: the kit has no words, numbers or letters; labels stay game text

needs: the game's boot function (first step, ?t= fast-forward, first animation frame), moved into GameDNA_Assets' onReady callback (L-00 loader)
every panel draw site with its rect; every item / status draw site with its box; the selected-row highlight and the pointer
a map from the game's item ids to the kit's icon keys
optional: skins/skin-api.js v0.5 (frame9 and icon bitmap roles) for modules that draw through a skin
provides: ui.frame(ctx, rect, {variant}) -> inner rect: nine-slice window / small / select / slot frames with a panel fill, corners never stretched
ui.icon(ctx, key, x, y, size) / ui.select(ctx, rect, t) / ui.cursor(ctx, x, y, h)
ui.attach(GameDNA_Skin, {skins}): frame9 roles window/banner/tooltip/plate, icon role for every icon and alias, skin.icon() for the G-01 shop
assets.json manifest: prompts, GEN.md, model, date and sha256 of every shipped file; tools/uikit.py (icon-sheet split, nine-slice cut) and kitcheck.py

assets: module/painted-ui.js: GameDNA_PaintedUI helper (one global, no dependencies; uses GameDNA_Assets from L-00)
assets/assets.json: manifest of 6 generated files (WebP, 113 KB), with prompts, GEN.md, meta and sha256 per Codex run under assets/gen/
assets/prompts/: style lock (L-00's), frames / icon-sheet briefs and the general templates.md
tools/uikit.py (icon-sheet split, nine-slice cut, slot / cursor trim), tools/build_kit.py; tools/assets/assetcheck.py frame9 check (shared)
skinSpec: v0.5 bitmap roles frame9 and icon (skins/SPEC.md 2.7)
